Dialog_TrustText
data.value: A paired phone is asking to control this laptop's pointer and keyboard. Trust it only if it is yours. If you do not answer in {0} s, it is not trusted.

data.name: Security_Level1Note
data.value: A new phone needs your yes here. Nothing else is asked.

data.name: Security_Level2Note
data.value: The phone also types the PIN, once. It is remembered until the PIN or the level changes.

data.name: Security_Level3Note
data.value: The phone types the PIN every time it connects.

data.name: Security_Intro
data.value: Every phone needs your yes here first. Levels 2 and 3 also ask for a six-digit PIN, typed on the phone's screen. Phones are disconnected while this window is open.

data.name: Security_PinNote
data.value: Saving a new PIN or level makes phones that entered the PIN once enter it again.

data.name: Security_NoPhones
data.value: No phone is trusted yet. A phone is asked about the first time it connects.

data.name: Security_PinStaged
data.value: A new PIN will be saved.

data.name: Error_PinNotSaved
data.value: The PIN could not be saved, so nothing was changed. The log has the reason.

data.name: Error_LevelNotSaved
data.value: The level could not be saved, so the previous level still applies. The log has the reason.

data.name: Security_ForgetOneText
data.value: {0} ({1}) will have to be trusted here again before it can use this laptop. Phones stay disconnected while you decide.

data.name: Security_ForgetAllNamed
data.value: {0} will have to be trusted here again before it can use this laptop, the one connected included. Phones stay disconnected while you decide.

data.name: Security_ForgetAllEvery
data.value: Every phone will have to be trusted here again before it can use this laptop, the one connected included. Phones stay disconnected while you decide.

data.name: Security_ResetHeading
data.value: Reset the PIN and forget every phone?

data.name: Security_ResetText
data.value: The PIN is deleted, the level goes back to 1 and every trusted phone is forgotten. Each phone, the one connected included, will have to be trusted here again. A forgotten PIN cannot be recovered, only reset.
